title: Paradise X #3 Marvel Comics 2002 Alex Ross Cover Krueger Braithwaite X-Men
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Paradise X #3 (2002), Marvel Comics. Written by Jim Krueger with Alex Ross, art by Doug Braithwaite and Bill Reinhold, painted cover by Alex Ross. Part of the Earth X / Universe X / Paradise X saga.

Back cover: 100 Day Marvel Gift Pack Giveaway (Spider-Man) ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
